name: molecular docking benchmarking instances
description: Molecular docking is an essential tool for drug design. It helps the scientist to rapidly know if two molecules, respectively called ligand and receptor, can be combined together to obtain a stable complex. We propose a new multi-objective model combining an energy term and a surface term to gain such complexes. The aim of our model is to provide complexes with a low energy and low surface. This model has been validated with two multi-objective genetic algorithms on instances from the literature dedicated to the docking benchmarking.
reputation: A niche research benchmark used in the molecular docking and multi-objective optimization literature rather than a widely standardized community leaderboard.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; results are instance- and algorithm-dependent, and there is no single standardized score scale.
